userStories.title: Login endpoint rejects ambiguous JSON request bodies
userStories.description: POST /api/auth/login currently uses raw json.NewDecoder which silently accepts and ignores trailing JSON values after the first one and imposes no body-size cap. Harden it to use the shared httputil.ReadJSON helper so ambiguous or oversized request bodies are rejected with a clear validation error before any credential lookup happens.
acceptance: Given a POST /api/auth/login whose body contains two concatenated JSON objects, when the handler decodes the request, then it responds 400 InvalidLoginRequest without performing a user lookup.
Given a POST /api/auth/login whose body is larger than httputil.MaxBodySize, when the handler decodes the request, then it responds 400 InvalidLoginRequest without performing a user lookup.
Given a well-formed POST /api/auth/login, when the handler decodes the request, then existing happy path and unauthorized paths continue to behave identically.
